text: Use the usual degree of a genuine isogeny. qualification: Heading or whitespace; no mathematical import.

text: This calculation proves that epsilon is sign-valued. It does not prove that its class is zero, produce a splitting cochain, or imply that a splitting cochain has finite image. If a later construction requires such a cochain, its domain, continuity, coefficient action and splitting theorem must be supplied separately. Sign-valued cocycles need not be coboundaries on an arbitrary fixed finite quotient. Likewise continuity or finite image of d requires the corresponding property of the chosen mu_sigma family; it is not a consequence of pointwise degree normalization.
qualification: Explicitly excludes finite cochain splitting and continuity from the degree conclusion.

text: ## Conductor bridge, conditional on the actual representations
qualification: Heading or whitespace; no mathematical import.
Heading or whitespace; no mathematical import.

text: Fix a rational prime p and choose an auxiliary prime ell different from p. Suppose the actual geometric and modular two-dimensional ell-adic representations in one specified family are isomorphic as G_Q representations. Restriction gives an isomorphism on a decomposition group at p and on every inertia and ramification subgroup. The dimensions of inertia-invariants agree, as do all terms defining the Swan conductor. Therefore their Artin conductor exponents agree. This argument works separately for each constructed family; an isomorphism or endomorphism calculation for the b-family does not supply the beta-family premise.
qualification: Restricts each separately supplied actual global isomorphism to the local ramification groups, preserving inertia dimensions, Swan and Artin conductor. Uses ell different from p.
Heading or whitespace; no mathematical import.

text: An independent local compatibility/conductor theorem must identify the modular representation exponent with v_p(N_f), where N_f is the primitive newform's level. That theorem must cover p dividing N_f and the actual coefficient embedding. The Tate-module identification alone does not supply this assertion. A fixed auxiliary prime ell=3 cannot be used for this argument at p=3. To state a product conductor formula for a larger Tate module, the direct-sum multiplicities and coefficient-field degrees must also be checked explicitly.
qualification: The two current Carayol level applications supply the separate modular conductor theorem at every p with ell different from p. The last larger-Tate-module sentence is only a warning about an additional multiplicity premise.
